## Purpose
The vault API (Settings → Vault, and the build prerequisites dialog). Values go in and never come back out, except as hints, non-sensitive values, or an audited reveal.

## Responsibilities
`vaultApi`:
- overview (`GET /api/vault`);
- get, create, update (PATCH), setValue (`PUT /secrets/{ref}/value`);
- reveal (`POST`), versions, rollback, remove;
- audit;
- candidates;
- rotateKey and generateKey.

## Key elements
`vaultApi`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
HTTP. The `X-Vault-Token` header is added by `client.ts`.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `routes/vault.py`.
- **Used by:** `components/vault` and the build-prerequisites dialogs.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Writes fail without the admin token when `VAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN` is set.

## Nuances and gotchas
Reads return a hint (for example "••••3f9a") instead of the value.

## How to rebuild this file
As above.
